_comment_version: This file demonstrates ALL possible configuration parameters
_comment_usage: Copy and modify for your patient case. Most parameters are optional.
_comment_docs: See README.md for detailed documentation of each parameter

case_info.description: Complete example showing all configuration options
case_info.reference: Optional: Publication DOI, clinical trial ID, etc.

simulation_settings._comment: Profile selection - determines solver, mesh resolution, and numerical schemes
simulation_settings._comment_override: Can be overridden via CLI: --profile sim_rans_fine

physics._comment_viscosity: Dynamic viscosity. Units: Pa·s. Normal range: 0.003-0.005. Default: 0.004
physics._comment_note: System auto-calculates kinematic viscosity nu = mu/rho

geometry._comment_scale: Multiply STL coordinates by this. 0.001 converts mm to meters
geometry._comment_rotation: Whether to rotate geometry to align inlet with target_normal
geometry._comment_target: Target normal vector for inlet after rotation (if enabled)
geometry._comment_patches: Patch keywords for STL file identification
geometry._comment_inlet: Keywords to identify inlet STL file (e.g., 'inlet', 'inflow')
geometry._comment_outlet: Ordered list of outlet patch names matching STL files
geometry._comment_wall: Keywords to identify wall STL file (e.g., 'wall', 'aorta')
geometry._comment_case: Case name for output directories (auto-set from patient_id if omitted)

computational._comment_parallel: Enable parallel processing for mesh generation and solving
computational._comment_max_proc: Maximum number of processor cores to use (or 'auto')

mesh._comment: Mesh generation settings - typically auto-configured by profiles
mesh._comment_note: Most mesh parameters are set by profiles. Override only if needed.

boundary_layers._comment: Automatic first layer thickness calculation from target y+ value
boundary_layers._comment_target_yplus: Target y+ value (e.g., 1.0 for RANS, 30 for wall functions). null = use manual finalLayerThickness
boundary_layers._comment_when_to_use: Set target_yplus for RANS/LES simulations where y+ control is critical

_option_auto._comment: Auto mode estimates from geometry + typical cardiac output (5 L/min)
_option_auto._comment_override1: Optional: Specify characteristic_velocity (m/s) to override estimated velocity
_option_auto._comment_override2: Optional: Specify characteristic_length (m) to override inlet diameter

_option_user_provided._comment_velocity: Typical velocity in m/s (e.g., peak systolic or time-averaged)
_option_user_provided._comment_length: Hydraulic diameter in meters (e.g., inlet diameter)

boundary_layers._comment_example_rans: Example for RANS k-omega SST: target_yplus=1.0, estimation_method='auto'
boundary_layers._comment_example_les: Example for LES WALE: target_yplus=1.0, estimation_method='auto'
boundary_layers._comment_example_wall_fn: Example for wall functions: target_yplus=30, estimation_method='auto'
boundary_layers._comment_calculation: System calculates: Δy₁ = y+ × ν / u_τ, where u_τ estimated from pipe flow correlations
boundary_layers._comment_output: Logs show: Reynolds number, friction velocity, calculated finalLayerThickness, total BL thickness
boundary_layers._comment_validation: Post-simulation: Verify actual y+ using built-in y+ post-processing

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_nProc: Number of processors for meshing (can differ from solver)
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_advanced: Advanced mesh control - usually set by profile
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_layers: Boundary layer settings (auto-calculated if target_yplus is set)
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_addLayer: Number of boundary layers (MUST use 'addLayer' not 'nSurfaceLayers'). Typical: 3-5 for laminar, 5-7 for RANS/LES
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_expansion: Layer growth ratio. Typical: 1.1-1.3. Lower = more uniform, higher = faster transition
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_final: Relative thickness (if relativeSizes=true). AUTO-CALCULATED if target_yplus is set
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_min: Minimum layer thickness to prevent collapse
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_relative: true = relative to local cell size, false = absolute in meters

mesh._comment_resolution: Mesh resolution controlled by profile fragments
mesh._comment_priority: Priority values (10-25) set refinement levels via profiles

run_settings._comment_subdomains: Number of processor subdomains for parallel solving
run_settings._comment_skip: If true, skip automatic reconstructPar after solver (21% faster)

_option1_TIMEVARYING._comment: Time-varying flow from CSV file (most common)
_option1_TIMEVARYING._comment_csv: CSV file in patient directory with time,value columns

_option2_CONSTANT._alternative: OR specify cardiac_output in L/min (auto-calculates velocity)

windkessel_settings._comment_split_meaning: If number: first N-1 outlets share X%, last gets (100-X)%
windkessel_settings._comment_method: Options: murray (r³ law) | area | equal | custom
windkessel_settings._comment_pwv: Pulse wave velocity for compliance calculation
windkessel_settings._comment_pwv_value: If pwv_method=measured, provide PWV in m/s
windkessel_settings._comment_tau: RC time constant (seconds). Range: 1.0-2.5. Should be ~60-80% of cardiac cycle period.
windkessel_settings._comment_auto_calc: The system automatically calculates R1, R2, C from pressures above.
windkessel_settings._comment_calculation: MAP = DP + (SP-DP)/3, R_total = (MAP-Pv)/Q_mean, R1 = ρ×PWV/A, R2 = R_total-R1, C = τ/R2
windkessel_settings._comment_R1: Proximal resistance (Pa·s/m³). AUTO-CALCULATED from PWV. Typical: 1e5-5e5
windkessel_settings._comment_R2: Distal resistance (Pa·s/m³). AUTO-CALCULATED from MAP. Typical: 1e6-5e6
windkessel_settings._comment_C: Compliance (m³/Pa). AUTO-CALCULATED from tau and R2. Typical: 5e-7 to 2e-6
windkessel_settings._comment_example_output: Example auto-calculated values for SP=123, DP=60, HR=120:
windkessel_settings._comment_see_docs: See examples/windkessel_parameters_example.md for detailed calculation methodology

_option2_PRESSURE._comment_pressure: Fixed pressure in Pa (80 mmHg = 10666 Pa)

_option_moving_wall._comment: For FSI or prescribed wall motion

simulation_control._comment_cycles: Number of cardiac cycles to simulate
simulation_control._comment_end_time: Options: 'auto' (from CSV) | numeric value in seconds
simulation_control._comment_maxCo: Maximum Courant number for adjustable time step
simulation_control._comment_maxDeltaT: Maximum time step size for adjustable stepping

_comment_profiles: AVAILABLE PROFILES (set via simulation_settings or --profile flag):
_comment_docs: See README.md and examples/ for more details
